title: Northloop Protect Plans Eligibility Sheet: Item Categories, Conditions, Price Range and Purchase Window
content:
Each of the Northloop Protect Plans can be added only to an item of an eligible category and condition, with a unit price inside the plan's eligible price range, and only within the plan's purchase window, counted in calendar days after the covered item's order date.

## Eligibility by plan

| Plan | Eligible item categories | Eligible item conditions | Lowest eligible item price (USD) | Highest eligible item price (USD) | Purchase window |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Protect 1-Year Extended Warranty | Electronics, computers, home and kitchen, large appliances, furniture | New, renewed | 10.00 | 5000.00 | 30 calendar days after the order date |
| Protect 2-Year Extended Warranty | Electronics, computers, home and kitchen, large appliances, furniture | New, renewed | 10.00 | 5000.00 | 30 calendar days after the order date |
| Protect 3-Year Extended Warranty | Electronics, computers, home and kitchen, large appliances, furniture | New, renewed | 10.00 | 5000.00 | 30 calendar days after the order date |
| Protect 2-Year Accident Protection | Electronics, computers, home and kitchen | New, renewed | 10.00 | 2500.00 | 30 calendar days after the order date |
| Protect 3-Year Accident Protection | Electronics, computers, home and kitchen | New, renewed | 10.00 | 2500.00 | 30 calendar days after the order date |
| Protect 4-Year Accident Protection | Electronics, computers, home and kitchen | New, renewed | 10.00 | 2500.00 | 30 calendar days after the order date |

## Differences between the two plan families

- **Categories.** Large appliances and furniture are eligible only on the three Extended Warranty plans; electronics, computers and home and kitchen items are eligible on all six plans.
- **Price ceiling.** The highest eligible item price is 5000.00 USD on the Extended Warranty plans and 2500.00 USD on the Accident Protection plans. The lowest eligible item price is 10.00 USD on every plan.
- **Shared terms.** Every plan accepts items in new or renewed condition only, and every plan has a purchase window of 30 calendar days after the covered item's order date.

## Hypothetical items checked against the sheet

| Hypothetical item | Category | Condition | Unit price (USD) | Extended Warranty plans | Accident Protection plans |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sofa | Furniture | New | 1800.00 | Category and price eligible | Category not eligible |
| Laptop | Computers | Renewed | 3200.00 | Category and price eligible | Above the 2500.00 ceiling |
| Headphones | Electronics | Used | 120.00 | Condition not eligible | Condition not eligible |
| Blender | Home and kitchen | New | 8.50 | Below the 10.00 floor | Below the 10.00 floor |

A plan bought on the 12th calendar day after a hypothetical item's order date is inside the 30-day purchase window; one sought on the 45th calendar day is outside it.
